summary: Giyu Tomioka awakened the Demon Slayer Mark while fighting Akaza, dramatically increasing his physical abilities. His marked state allowed him to contend with a serious Akaza, later fight Muzan, and clash with Sanemi strongly enough for their Nichirin swords to become bright red.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

notes: The Demon Slayer Mark increases Giyu's strength and speed by an order of magnitude. His marked state allowed him to keep up with serious Akaza and survive his Blue Silver Chaotic Afterglow. His Constant Flux and Bright Red Nichirin Sword can increase his effectiveness further.
